findings.code:
import scipy.stats as st
A_conv=296
A_total=3000
B_conv=389
B_total=3000
p1=A_conv/A_total
p2=B_conv/B_total
p_pool=(A_conv+B_conv)/(A_total+B_total)
z=(p1-p2)/((p_pool*(1-p_pool)*(1/A_total+1/B_total))**0.5)
print('z',z)
print('p-value two-sided',2*(1-st.norm.cdf(abs(z))))
print('p-value one-sided',1-st.norm.cdf(z))
